name: Frank Filbert
mentions: …representatives who saw the animal when it was caught up were new men and unacquainted with the facts. Frank Filbert, who was with the round-up, knew the animal and all the circumstances of the branding, but did not happen to be present when the animal was caught up. This was the reaso…
Frank Filbert was thrown from his horse last Monday and had his collar-bone broken and his shoulder badly smashed. The accident will probably lay him up for some time.
